proposal.title: Convert DRI CP/M with Platform Extensions — Aurelia software to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: DRI CP/M with Platform Extensions — Aurelia software
before.description: DRI-owned CP/M 1.4-derived software with the Aurelia platform extensions, supporting Aurelia and Aurelia+. It combines CP/M application/file services with text-mode TUI, smart-device/FlexiBUS integration, XIP cartridge support and named user areas. DRI owns the resulting CP/M version and its software enhancements and licenses it non-exclusively. The Logix-produced physical ROM cartridge is a separate offering and device. AION develops and delivers the TUI implementation to DRI under the three-party agreement, retaining cross-platform reuse rights. Logix supplies boot firmware and hardware drivers.

specification.description: DRI retains ownership and non-exclusive licensing rights.
Defines the software image, interfaces and supported Aurelia platforms, separate from physical manufacture.
Defines collaboration, DRI software ownership and the scope of non-exclusive licensing.
Develops the TUI and delivers source, tests and documentation to DRI while retaining cross-platform reuse rights.
